text:
->The undefiled, pure light,
The sun of wisdom that shatters all darkness,
Can subdue the disasters of wind and fire,
And brilliantly illuminate the world.<-

->With a body of compassion like the thunder of precepts,
And a mind of loving-kindness like a great, wondrous cloud,
Pouring down the sweet rain of the Dharma,
To extinguish the flames of affliction.<-

->In disputes before officials,
Or in the terror of the battlefield,
If one calls upon the power of Avalokiteshvara <note>original: "觀世音"</note>,
All enemies will retreat and disperse.<-

->The wondrous voice, the voice of the world-observer,
The Brahma-voice, the voice like the rising tide,
Surpasses all sounds of the world;
Therefore, one must constantly keep it in mind.<-

->In every thought, do not harbor doubt.
Avalokiteshvara, the pure and holy one,
In the midst of suffering, agony, disaster, and death,
Can serve as a refuge and protector.<-

->Possessing all virtues,
Looking upon all beings with eyes of compassion,
An ocean of accumulated blessings beyond measure;
Therefore, one should bow in reverence.<-

---

->At that time, the Bodhisattva Earth-Holder <note>original: "持地菩薩"</note> immediately arose from his seat, came forward, and said to the Buddha, "World-Honored One! If there are beings who hear this chapter on the free-acting deeds of the Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara and his manifestation of supernatural powers through the universal gate, know that the merit of such persons will not be small." When the Buddha spoke this Universal Gate chapter, eighty-four thousand beings in the assembly all generated the heart of supreme, peerless, and perfect enlightenment <note>original: "阿耨多羅三藐三菩提"</note>.<note>This term refers to Anuttara-samyak-sambodhi, the highest level of Buddha-wisdom.</note><-
